question: Should AgentHarness fail closed on malformed tool descriptors, or skip invalid descriptors while keeping healthy sibling tools available?
rationale: Both open drafts are plausible robustness fixes for the same boundary, but they create incompatible runtime semantics for malformed tools and existing callers.

options.title: Resolve The Registry Contract First
options.body: Pause both drafts until maintainers choose fail-closed validation or skip-invalid availability, then update or close the non-canonical branch.

options.title: Adopt Fail-Closed Validation
options.body: Land this PR if malformed tool providers should stop registration with a stable AgentHarnessError instead of being filtered or failing later.

options.title: Prefer Skip-Invalid Availability
options.body: Continue with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/89136 if healthy sibling tools should remain usable when one descriptor is malformed.

recommendation.title: Resolve The Registry Contract First
recommendation.body: Pause both drafts until maintainers choose fail-closed validation or skip-invalid availability, then update or close the non-canonical branch.

likelyOwner.reason: He is assigned to this PR and owns both competing registry-policy branches.
